newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ OCCUPANCY RATE FALLS TO 36.1 PCT IN JUNE - SNZ.
newsitem.headline: NZ OCCUPANCY RATE FALLS TO 36.1 PCT IN JUNE - SNZ.

text.p: The national occupancy rate excluding caravan parks and camping grounds fell to 36.1 percent in June from 40.5 percent in May, Statistics New Zealand said on Monday.
Motels recorded an occupancy rate of 39.3 percent in June, the highest rate recorded by the accommodation types but down from 42.7 percent in May.

"All of the accommodation types recorded decreases in occupancy from May to June. Hotels had the largest decrease, down 6.5 percentage points from 44.7 percent in May to 38.2 percent in June," SNZ said.
